versions.changelog:
Version 1.2.0

- Updated the skill homepage URL to include UTM parameters for improved referral tracking.
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- No functional or CLI/API changes.

- Skill description updated to focus on PDF page management: merge, insert, reorder, exchange, and crop operations.
- New examples in the description clarify supported queries such as merging, inserting, and rearranging PDF pages.
- Previous references to document comparison, watermark management, and text analysis removed from the skill description.
- Command reference, installation, activation, and options remain unchanged.

Security & Transparency
- Added official source declaration for CLI download (download.compdf.com)
- Download flow now notifies user of source before proceeding
- License activation clarifies email is used solely for trial license; requires user confirmation
- Security & Privacy table expanded with download endpoint, user consent column, and official source statement (PDF Technologies, Inc.)

Initial release — PDF Editor CLI Tool for advanced PDF processing

- Enables automated editing and processing of PDFs via ComPDFKit CLI: split, merge, extract, insert, rotate, and delete pages.
- Supports document comparison, PDF optimization & compression, and file format conversion (PDF/A, PDF/X, PDF/UA, etc.).
- Provides comprehensive watermark management (add/remove).
- Automatic platform detection, CLI download/installation, and license activation included.
- Designed for robust post-processing and reorganization of PDF files, supporting both Windows and macOS.
